card.name: Linking words before condition names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, of, had, including, were, one, multiple) that come right before a named medical condition, such as infection, fracture, thyroid disease or renal disease, in trial results and warnings.

modes.label: Linking word before an outcome
modes.description: Words like or, of, or including that sit between a count or category and a disease or event term.
modes.example: a composite renal endpoint of all-cause mortality<< or>> progression to end stage renal disease

modes.label: Had, were or one before findings
modes.description: A verb or quantity word after a percentage of patients, leading into an adverse finding.
modes.example: 18% (34/184) of patients randomized to POTELIGEO<< had>> Grade 3 or higher infection or an
